blocks.text: Today’s headlines: Mary Jane Veloso, West Ph Sea, Carlos Yulo
Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Mary Jane Veloso finally free after 16 years

blocks.text: Former OFW Mary Jane Veloso walks free after 16 years in jail, following her pardon by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday September 25.

items: China ‘hinders’ PH resupply mission to Ayungin Shoal

blocks.text: For the first time since Manila and Beijing signed a “provisional understanding,” Chinese maritime forces quote-unquote “hindered” a mission to the BRP Sierra Madre at Ayungin Shoal.

items: Barangay, SK elections postponed to November 2028

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signs Republic Act No. 12326, fixing the term of barangay officials and Sangguniang Kabataan members to five years.

items: At UN, Netanyahu defends Israel as delegates walk out

blocks.text: Delegates at the United Nations walked out of the hall as Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu delivers his speech to the meeting of world leaders.

items: Carlos Yulo redeems self, vaults to another Asian Games gold

blocks.text: Filipino gymnast Carlos Yulo captures a second artistic gymnastics gold medal for the Philippines in the 2026 Asian Games, Friday, September 25. – Rappler.com
